name: Marked for Eternity
source:
You (the MC) live in West Mountain, a town that—on the surface—appears pretty mundane. However, you soon discover that this seemingly normal town has many mysteries, secrets and a dark history of supernatural wars.

When you were only 4 years old, your mother passed away in a car accident. 11 years later, tragedy struck again: your father abruptly fell into a coma for "unknown reasons" and was hospitalized. After that, you moved in with your stepmother Stephanie and her daughters (your stepsisters) in West Mountain.

In this supernatural/sci-fi story, you'll unravel the mysteries of West Mountain and the reason behind your father's condition—and of course, you'll also try your luck with gorgeous girls along the way.

"Where there are answers, there lie only more questions."

[From [url=https://horn-nii-san.itch.io/marked-for-eternity]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你（主持人）住在西山，一个表面上看起来很平凡的小镇。然而，你很快就会发现这个看似正常的小镇却隐藏着许多谜团、秘密和超自然战争的黑暗历史。

当你只有4岁的时候，你的母亲在一场车祸中去世了。11年后，悲剧再次降临：你的父亲因“不明原因”突然陷入昏迷，住院治疗。之后，你搬到西山与继母斯蒂芬妮和她的女儿们（你的继姐妹）住在一起。

在这个超自然/科幻故事中，你将揭开西山之谜以及你父亲病情背后的原因——当然，你也会一路上碰碰运气。

“只要有答案，就会有更多问题。”

[来自[url=https://horn-nii-san.itch.io/marked-for-eternity]itch.io[/url]]
